method_versioning.id_policy: Any algorithm, threshold, window, sign, reference-plane, or invalidation change requires a new feature_algorithm_id. Store both old and new results.
method_versioning.config_digest_policy: SHA256 of canonicalized immutable JSON configuration to be selected and published at freeze; no digest claimed yet.
method_versioning.input_policy: Bind original raw artifact SHA-256 + exact hash scope, samplerate and observer plane; no WAV inference.
method_versioning.comparable_when: SAME_METHOD and same pin/load/observer/reference plane, or both sides recomputed from independently verified raw with same newer method

analysis_profile.frame_rule: Only complete frames starting at 0,960,1920,... with start+3840<=N; no edge padding; time is original zero-based sample index/fs. For N=24000, 22 complete frames.
analysis_profile.nonfinite_rule: Reject numeric feature if any selected input sample is nonfinite, record INVALID_NUMERIC rather than zero.
analysis_profile.raw_domain: native model pressure Pa at nominal 0.20m proxy; no gain normalization, dBFS or absolute SPL

methods.name: level
methods.input: qualified unnormalized native raw pressure x[n] in Pa; full record and optional fixed full frames
methods.formula: rms=sqrt(sum(x[n]^2)/N) (no mean removal); mean=sum(x[n])/N; peak=max(abs(x[n])); proxy_db=20*log10(rms/1Pa) only if rms>0

window.frame_weight: rectangular; Hann not applied to amplitude RMS

test_plan.expected: rms=2 Pa, mean=2 Pa, peak=2 Pa, proxy_db=6.020599913 dB

methods.name: f0_observed
methods.input: qualified raw pressure, no preview; 48k profile 80ms windows
methods.formula: For each Hann-windowed mean-subtracted frame, normalized ACF rho[k]=sum_n x[n]x[n+k]/sqrt(sum_n x[n]^2 * sum_n x[n+k]^2) on valid overlap; find maximum positive rho over lags ceil(fs/400) through floor(fs/70); f0=fs/k using discrete integer lag (no peak interpolation in v0 candidate); summary median of accepted frames.

config.lag_tie_break: smallest lag; if octave-related competitor within 0.05 normalized ACF, invalidate

methods.claim_limit: observed output periodicity candidate, not prescribed LF F0, vocal-fold action or biological source proof

test_plan.expected: candidate near 100Hz within discretization; exact tolerance to preregister
invalid or quantified false-positive rate; not validated

methods.name: harmonic_tilt
methods.input: 80ms Hann frames with f0_observed accepted; raw output only
methods.formula: Compute one-sided 8192-point zero-padded magnitude DFT of demeaned Hann frame. For k=2..10 find maximum magnitude in +/-1 FFT bin from round(k*f0*8192/fs). Fit ordinary least-squares y=20log10(magnitude), x=log2((k*f0)/1Hz), slope in dB/oct; median per-frame slope.

config.fit: unweighted linear least squares log2 frequency vs amplitude dB

invalid_rules.if: no qualified f0 or too few harmonic peaks
peak outside Nyquist or lower than relative floor

methods.claim_limit: OUTPUT harmonic tilt including filter/load; not glottal source spectral tilt

test_plan.fixture: synthetic sum of harmonics with known imposed log-frequency amplitude slope

methods.name: resonance_peak_candidates
methods.input: qualified complex transfer H(f) with same load, port/observer and phasor convention; not arbitrary output FFT
methods.formula: Compute |H(f)| on native registered monotonically increasing frequency grid. Candidate i is a strict local maximum (value larger than both neighbors) with >=3dB prominence versus nearest local minima on both sides; sort ascending frequency. No interpolation in v0.

config.phasor_sign: must be supplied by artifact, not assumed

invalid_rules.if: different port/load/plane, nonmonotone f or missing phasor sign

methods.claim_limit: model transfer peak candidates only; not anatomical formants or measured speech formants

test_plan.fixture: synthetic complex transfer with one known resonance
test_plan.expected: one candidate in registered grid, threshold check

methods.name: output_spectral_peaks
methods.input: qualified raw Pa and registered fixed 80ms Hann FFT output windows
methods.formula: 8192-point DFT, magnitude log spectrum of mean-subtracted Hann frame; find strict interior local maxima with >=3dB prominence over flanking nearest minima; report per-frame frequency grid peaks sorted ascending (no physical formant label).

config.aggregation: per-frame array; no cross-frame formant tracking

methods.claim_limit: observed spectral peaks; not transfer-function resonances

test_plan.expected: report peaks near fixed FFT bins

methods.name: noise_proxy
methods.input: qualified raw Pa, accepted f0 windows, fixed 80ms Hann FFT
methods.formula: In 70..4000Hz one-sided magnitude-squared spectrum, mask all bins within +/-1 bin around each integer harmonic of accepted f0. Residual energy=sum unmasked powers, total=sum all band powers. ratio=residual/total; residual_db=10log10(ratio) if ratio>0; ratio=0 yields db=null ZERO_RESIDUAL.
methods.claim_limit: model numerical residual only; not actual breathiness, airflow turbulence or biological noise

test_plan.expected: possible leakage residual; do not assert zero

test_plan.fixture: harmonic plus known injected off-mask tones

methods.name: time_features
methods.formula: For each complete frame compute non-demeaned RMS. Candidate onset is the start sample of first of >=2 consecutive frames whose RMS >= max(frame_RMS)*10^(-30/20). If max RMS=0, onset is null. Store original frame start indices; no end padding.

invalid_rules.if: all-zero or no two qualifying frames

methods.claim_limit: model energy onset only, NOT gesture, contact or physiological onset

test_plan.expected: first qualifying frame start within preregistered frame tolerance
